name: YOURLIFEWITHERIK
source:
In this game, you can follow an alternate route: stay with Erik and strengthen your bond with him, or attempt to escape and leave him behind..

[From [url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/yourlifewitherik]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你可以选择另一条路线：留在埃里克身边并加强与他的联系，或者尝试逃跑并把他抛在身后。

[来自[url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/yourlifewitherik]Itch.io[/url]]
